# Last updated: 2026-08-14

> PDFdukan is a free, privacy-first collection of browser-based PDF and document tools. Each tool page states its supported inputs, outputs, processing method, and important limitations. Based in Pakistan, serving users globally.

## Site Purpose
PDFdukan provides free online tools for PDF conversion, compression, merging, splitting, OCR, and document scanning. The flagship product is CamMaster — an AI document scanner with auto edge detection, Magic Pro filters, and Google Drive integration.

## Primary Pages
- [Home — Free PDF Tools & Document Scanner](https://pdfdukan.com/): Overview of all tools and CamMaster scanner
- [CamMaster Scanner](https://pdfdukan.com/scanner.html): AI-powered document scanner — scan, crop, enhance, export to PDF/JPG
- [CamScanner Alternatives](https://pdfdukan.com/alternatives.html): Evidence-linked comparison of current browser, Android and iPhone document-scanning workflows
- [All Tools](https://pdfdukan.com/tools.html): Curated PDF and document tools
- [Blog](https://pdfdukan.com/blog/index.html): In-depth guides on PDF tools, document scanning, and productivity

## Core PDF Tools
- [JPG and PNG to PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/img-to-pdf.html): Combine source images into PDF pages; output sharpness depends on source pixels and page sizing
- [PDF to JPG or PNG](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/pdf-to-img.html): Rasterize selected PDF pages at a chosen DPI; text becomes pixels
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/merge-pdf.html): Combine and reorder selected PDF pages locally; verify complex forms and annotations
- [Split PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/split-pdf.html): Extract PDF pages or ranges locally, subject to browser memory
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/compress-pdf.html): Rasterize PDF pages at a selected quality to attempt file-size reduction
- [Image to Text OCR](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/ocr.html): Recognize editable English, Urdu, Arabic and other printed text with browser-based Tesseract.js
- [Smart Document Scan](https://pdfdukan.com/scanner.html): ONNX corner detection with OpenCV fallback, manual crop correction, filters and PDF/JPG export
- [Image Compressor and Resizer](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/compress.html): Resize or re-encode JPG, PNG and WebP; quality and target-size results vary
- [Searchable PDF from English Scan](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/searchable-pdf.html): Add an approximate invisible OCR word layer to one English JPG or PNG scan
- [HTML to PDF Print Preview](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/html-to-pdf.html): Prepare one HTML document for the browser Print to PDF workflow; rendering can vary
- [Hanafi Islamic Inheritance Estimate](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/inheritance-calc-advanced.html): Educational faraid estimate, not a fatwa or legal distribution
- [Word to PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/word-to-pdf.html): Reconstruct common DOCX content as PDF; complex Word layouts can differ
- [PDF to Word](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/pdf-to-word.html): Reconstruct searchable PDF text and supported content into DOCX; manual cleanup may be required
- [PDF to Excel](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/pdf-to-excel.html): Infer worksheet rows and columns from positioned searchable-PDF text; verify extracted data
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/pdf-to-ppt.html): Place each PDF page as a non-editable full-slide image in PPTX
- [PDF Restriction Compatibility Check](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/unlock-pdf.html): Re-save supported unencrypted PDFs; does not decrypt files or bypass unknown passwords
- [Watermark PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/watermark.html): Add text watermark to PDF
- [Rotate, Reorder and Delete PDF Pages](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/pdf-organizer.html): One visual PDF Organizer for page rotation, ordering and removal
- [Fill & Sign PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/fill-sign.html): Fill and digitally sign PDF forms
- [Edit, Annotate & Sign PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/pdf-editor.html): Visually replace selectable text lines and add annotations, images, links, shapes and signatures; flattened output does not structurally rewrite PDF text objects
- [Islamic Inheritance Calculator](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/inheritance-calc-advanced.html): Estimate Islamic faraid inheritance shares

## OCR and Scanning
- [OCR — Searchable PDF](https://pdfdukan.com/tools/searchable-pdf.html): Make scanned PDFs searchable
- [CamMaster Scanner](https://pdfdukan.com/scanner.html): Detect document edges, crop, enhance and export scans

## Technical
- Sitemap: https://pdfdukan.com/sitemap.xml
- File-processing tools run client-side where the individual tool page explicitly states this
- No account required for basic tools
- Supports: JPG, PNG, WEBP, PDF input formats
- Output: PDF, JPG, PNG, ZIP
- PDF-to-PowerPoint creates image-based slides; existing slide text is not directly editable
- PDF-to-Excel works best on digital PDFs with selectable text; scanned PDFs require OCR first
- Unlock PDF does not crack an unknown password required to open a document
